parsed.label: Adjusted EBITDA

figures.quote: FMC first quarter Adjusted EBITDA was $72 million, a decrease of 40 percent from the prior-year period, driven by lower pricing and unfavorable costs.

parsed.notes: The excerpt contains no reconciliation table, so the figure comes from the narrative. The excerpt does not print the Q1 2025 dollar amount; it says only that Q1 2026 was down 40 percent from it. Outlook ranges for full-year 2026, Q2 and the half-years are guidance, not reported results, and are excluded.
